name: Zaklyattya
source:
What is it like to be a shadow? Hiding from the darkness of your own memories and at the same time trying to find answers to long-forgotten questions of the past, when the only way out is to face your fears face to face?
The visual novel 'Zaklyattya' is a story in which you will have to search for clues among the webs of your past lives, solve puzzles that will open new paths to freedom, and carefully monitor your actions. Only your choice depends on whether you will achieve the goal and who will come out alive from this story. Are you ready to challenge your own sanity and courage, face your fears and the puzzle? If your answer is 'yes' - we invite you to play the game and dive into the universe of the forest, dark dungeon and shadows bound by invisible chains in the depths of the Black Forest.

[Translated from [url=https://svichechka.itch.io/zaklyattya]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
成为影子是什么感觉？逃避自己记忆的黑暗，同时试图寻找过去早已被遗忘的问题的答案，而唯一的出路就是面对面地面对你的恐惧？
在视觉小说《Zaklyattya》中，你必须在前世的网络中寻找线索，解决谜题，打开新的自由之路，并仔细监控你的行动。只有你的选择取决于你能否实现目标以及谁将从这个故事中活着出来。你准备好挑战自己的理智和勇气，面对恐惧和困惑了吗？如果你的答案是“是” - 我们邀请你玩游戏并潜入黑森林深处的森林宇宙、黑暗地牢和被隐形锁链束缚的阴影。

[译自[url=https://svichechka.itch.io/zaklyattya]itch.io[/url]]
